name: composed-retrieval-all64-learned-product-radii-v1
theory: CM117, product radii on the first normalized read and query rotation.
training: One unit-initialized radius per original object shared on the value and query sides of the rotated product. Optimize every old coordinate and all radii from ordinary masked full-vocabulary CE for 1024 updates. Use the existing projected gate learning rate for each radius. Each case starts fresh at each seed and mode.
freeze: Two independent builds each train all 384 endpoints before either evaluates a held-out record. Compare raw initialization and matched minibatch receipts to CM116 on exactly the same 64 original cases. Preserve all original selection and greedy rollout rules.
